title: Venue blueprint (v3)
description: The blueprint the placement-editor authors and the engine serves (GET/PUT /blueprint). It places each level in its parent: the floor plan in the world (georef), each room in its floor plan, anchors and walls in their room. Every level uses the venue-frame convention, the local frame of omlox: x along the width, y along the depth, z up, right-handed, origin at the lower-left corner of the parent. Horizontal extents are width_m (x) and depth_m (y). height_m is vertical only. A room is placed in its floor plan by its lower-left corner (x_m, y_m) and a rotation clockwise on the plan about its centre (rotation_deg). The engine migrates version 1 and 2 documents to this version at load and on PUT. Lenient (additionalProperties allowed) so additive editor fields do not break validation.

scale_calibration_refs.description: Scale-calibration references: two floor-plan points and their known distance in metres.

point.description: [x, y] in metres in the frame of the enclosing level.

georef.description: Places the floor plan in the world. latitude/longitude locate its lower-left corner, azimuth_deg is the bearing of +y clockwise from true north.

altitude_m.description: Height of the origin above the WGS84 ellipsoid, in metres. Null when not surveyed. A value read from a map or a DEM is above mean sea level and takes the geoid undulation at the origin.

room.description: Room placed in its floor plan. Its own frame has the origin at its lower-left corner.

x_m.description: Lower-left corner along the floor-plan x.

y_m.description: Lower-left corner along the floor-plan y.

rotation_deg.description: Rotation clockwise on the plan about the room centre.

shape.description: Optional outline in room coordinates; overrides the rectangle. Edge i runs from shape[i] to shape[i+1].

perimeter_openings.description: Openings along the room outline. For a rectangle the sides are N (0,depth)->(width,depth), E (width,depth)->(width,0), S (0,0)->(width,0), W (0,depth)->(0,0), and an offset is measured from the first corner.

anchor.description: Positioning anchor in room coordinates. `technology` selects the adapter family.

z.description: Mounting height above the room floor, in metres.

wall.description: Wall segment in room coordinates. Openings are ranges along the segment, measured from (x1, y1).
